title: nvim crashes by nvim_buf_set_lines() when undolevels = -1

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Problem

Nvim crashes when the number of lines gets larger than the window height -- but this is possibly due to a plugin. ~~The root cause might be on somewhere `extmark`; I will try to modify the title and the reproduce step if I can find why the crash happens.~~

I find that this happens when we call `nvim_buf_set_lines` for a buffer with `undolevels = -1`.

With git bisect I figured out that 008154954 (#24824) is the first bad commit. /cc @bfredl

Stacktraces tell that `u_force_get_undo_header` via `extmark_splice_impl` is where it aborts.

### Steps to reproduce

`$ nvim -u minimal.lua` where minimal.lua:

```
local buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
vim.api.nvim_buf_set_option(buf, 'undolevels', -1)
vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, 0, 1, false, { })
```

### Steps to reproduce (old)

<details>
   <summary>Click to expand</summary>

This happens when I use [nvim-scrollview](https://github.com/dstein64/nvim-scrollview) written by @dstein64, so I will provide steps with the plugin enabled:

`$ nvim -u minimal.lua` where minimal.lua:

```
local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify("./.repro", ":p")
for _, name in ipairs({ "config", "data", "state", "cache" }) do
  vim.env[("XDG_%s_HOME"):format(name:upper())] = root .. "/" .. name
end
local lazypath = root .. "/plugins/lazy.nvim"
if not vim.loop.fs_stat(lazypath) then
  vim.fn.system({ "git", "clone", "--filter=blob:none", "https://github.com/folke/lazy.nvim.git", lazypath, })
end
vim.opt.runtimepath:prepend(lazypath)
local plugins = {
  'dstein64/nvim-scrollview';
}
require("lazy").setup(plugins, {
  root = root .. "/plugins",
})
```

And then

- Enter `<CR>` sufficient times to make scrollbar appear (e.g., the number of lines in the buffer exceeds the window height)
- or open any files with many enough lines

~I will try to narrow down to the root cause with (more) minimal steps to reproduce.~ UPDATE: See above.

</details>


### Expected behavior

No crashes.

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

0.10.0-dev 008154954

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A

### Operating system/version

macOS 12.3

### Terminal name/version

xterm

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

build from source (HEAD)
